_doc: Absolute expectations per archetype, ON TOP of the relative regression baseline (docs/EVALS.md#absolute-gates).
coverage: n < diagnostic_below → INSUFFICIENT COVERAGE (reported, never gated, never 'healthy'); diagnostic_below ≤ n < gate_eligible_from → provisional; n ≥ gate_eligible_from → gate eligible.
Rules: mean_floor (archetype mean), min_floor (catastrophic single slide), max_share_below_floor (share of slides under mean_floor).
status 'enforced' fails CI for gate-eligible archetypes; 'provisional' is reported only. Each rule states its rationale and evidence; change them like profiles (evals/profile_changes.md).

coverage.rationale: With n < 5 one slide moves the mean by 20+ points: a number, not evidence. 8 slides per archetype is what the v1.4 battery can afford to render on every commit and keeps one outlier's effect on the mean under ~10 points.

min_floor.rationale: Below 35 a slide is broken in every archetype seen so far: v1.3.3 text slides at 20–31 (tiny text top-left on an empty slide), KPI strips at 37, processes at 36. No accepted development slide scores below 45.

mean_floor.rationale: Engineering target of the v1.4 brief ('no important archetype mean << 70'); the editorial floor already used by candidate selection (compose.EDITORIAL_FLOOR = 70). Provisional until human r2 votes say where 'acceptable' starts.

max_share_below_floor.rationale: A healthy archetype keeps most slides above the editorial floor; a quarter below means a systematic problem, not an outlier. Provisional (no human evidence yet).
